inherited.M01: Cued imagined speech of the target words, text plus audio cue (imagined-speech EEG paradigm)
inherited.M03: Subject-specific calibration from about 30 minutes of offline trials (per-subject model lineage); heuristic dual-criterion early stopping
inherited.M05: 64-channel wet scalp EEG at 500 Hz, common average reference
inherited.M07: Closed four-class set, no language model
inherited.M09: Confidence-scaled visual and auditory feedback, cited by the target to its references 16 and 18
inherited.M10: No correction or undo step described

topics.inclusion_rule: EEG decoding studies (classification, text or speech decoding) that train a denoising diffusion model as part of the decoder, either jointly with a classifier, as a feature learner, or to generate training samples. Boundary: diffusion used only to synthesize EEG with no decoding result, reviews, and 'diffusion' in a non-generative sense (drift-diffusion, diffusion MRI) are excluded; versions of one study count once.
topics.metric: within-subject imagined-speech accuracy; parameter count; effect of removing the diffusion model

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that classify imagined, covert or inner speech from scalp EEG (same population as the M06 imagined-speech EEG table); the design compared is whether decoding is run online with feedback (real-time, closed-loop) and its accuracy reported, or offline on recorded trials. Boundary: a mention of real-time use as future work or in related work is a pattern match only, not an online study; reviews excluded as deciding priors; versions count once.
topics.design_field: published full-text pattern counts (online, real-time, closed-loop terms)
topics.metric: online accuracy with cohort size, sessions and chance level

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that classify imagined, covert or inner speech from scalp EEG (same ledger population as the M13 online-imagined-speech-eeg table); the design compared is whether reported accuracy is referenced against chance: a stated chance level or above-chance test, or an empirical permutation null. Boundary: full-text pattern counts are upper bounds (a chance mention in related work counts); a study whose full text never uses the word 'chance' is counted as giving no chance reference; versions count once.
topics.design_field: full-text design regexes: chance_reference, permutation_null, no_chance_term
topics.metric: whether accuracy is referenced to chance; per-class trial denominators
